# CORE-INT-01

**Does every connector that crosses a bounded context or the design's boundary carry a versioned contract?**

| | |
|---|---|
| Lens | [Core architecture lens](core.md) 0.6.0 |
| Area | INT: Interfaces and contracts |
| Default severity | major |
| Decided by | A tool, by its rule |
| Reads | `connectors.contract`, `elements.part_of` |

## Rule

Every connector that crosses a bounded context or the design's boundary has contract. A connector crosses when its ends' part_of differ, when exactly one end has part_of, or when either end is an actor, an external-system or a technology. For a connector from an actor, or to an interface a vendor provides, the contract names the channel or the vendor's published interface and its version.
